FINAL_SCIENTIFIC_CONCLUSION: The successor diagnostics establish that the original mean-pooled probe was a measurement bottleneck: preserving MineWorld's spatial hidden-state structure produces strong, independently replicated within-layout visible-position decoding, and that advantage collapses when stable token-slot correspondence is destroyed by a locked sample-specific scramble. However, held-out-layout transfer remains heterogeneous, and observed cross-layout performance is not clearly separated from an audited trajectory-block target null that preserves the dataset's stereotyped temporal position profile. The work therefore establishes spatial measurement sensitivity but does not establish robust target-specific cross-layout decoding, and the original uncertainty hypothesis remains unresolved.
adjudication_method: bounded evidence synthesis over the sealed Task 1-5 artifacts; no new fit, capture, extraction or recomputation was performed

control_b_grouped_target_null.authority_mapping: the audited permute_trajectory_blocks refuses a length stratum with fewer than two blocks; on this authority the 60-frame stratum holds 17 trajectories and the 51-frame stratum holds exactly one (layout_06_ep12616).  The audited function is therefore called verbatim on the 17-trajectory, 1,020-row equal-length stratum and the singleton block keeps its own target block.  Python's random.shuffle consumes no randomness for a one-element list, so this is bit-identical to running the audited function over all 18 trajectories with the minimum-stratum guard lifted.
control_b_grouped_target_null.conservatism: 51 of 1,071 rows (4.76%) retain their true feature-target association inside every null replicate, which can only make the null distribution stronger, never weaker
control_b_grouped_target_null.temporal_rule: frames are never rearranged inside a trajectory; the donor block is copied in the recipient's own frame order, so within-trajectory temporal correlation is preserved exactly and neighbouring frame targets are never independently shuffled

A_measurement_sensitivity.claim: Preserving spatial hidden-state organization materially improves visible-position decoding relative to global mean pooling.
A_measurement_sensitivity.explicitly_not_supported: The original failure cannot be summarized as 'MineWorld hidden states contain no readable visible-position information'; that statement is unsupported.
support: Within-layout equal-layout macro R2: GLOBAL 0.014819740599772898, COARSE_2x6 0.8249646147116141, FULL_TOKEN_GRID 0.815495540876805.
18/18 held-out trajectories beat GLOBAL for both COARSE and FULL; 6/6 layouts have a positive median delta.
The effect survives the move from the original six trajectories to the 18-trajectory authority.
It collapses under sample-specific destruction of stable token-slot identity (Control A).

B_spatial_organization.claim: Stable spatial token-slot identity matters strongly.
explicitly_not_claimed: not proof that individual tokens encode absolute position (transformer tokens are contextual)
B_spatial_organization.support: Locked sample-specific scramble over the 5 frozen seeds; ordered beats scrambled on every seed, both representations, both designs.

D_target_specificity_and_null.claim: Observed cross-layout performance is not clearly separated from the audited trajectory-block target null, which is strong because the visible-position target has a stereotyped temporal/ramp structure shared across trajectories.
D_target_specificity_and_null.verdict: The experiment does NOT establish that the spatial readout contains target-specific information beyond what preserved trajectory-level temporal structure can induce. This is a major limitation.

E_high_dimensionality.claim: FULL does not materially outperform COARSE despite 28x more features.
E_high_dimensionality.preference: COARSE_2x6 is preferred for future experiments unless a future result demonstrates unique value from FULL.
E_high_dimensionality.verdict: FULL's result is NOT concluded to be merely high-dimensional overfit, and high-dimensional overfit is NOT concluded to be eliminated. HIGH_DIMENSIONAL_OVERFIT_PLAUSIBLE=Unclear is retained.

limitations: Exploratory throughout: this is not a confirmatory pass and no confirmatory gate was defined, met, or retrospectively applied.
Layer 4 remains EXPLORATORY_PRESELECTED_FROM_EXISTING_POSITIVE_CONTROL; no layer sweep was run, so the layer choice is inherited, not established.

Observed across-layout performance is NOT clearly separated from the audited grouped target null (COARSE empirical percentile 83.0, upper-tail statistic 0.178; FULL 59.0 and 0.416). Target-specific cross-layout decoding is NOT established.

The audited null is strong because x_true_blocks carries a stereotyped ramp shared across trajectories; a whole-trajectory block permutation therefore leaves much of the target profile predictable. This is a property of the capture design, not of the readout.

Null mapping conservatism: layout_06_ep12616 is the sole 51-frame trajectory and forms a singleton audited length stratum, so it retains its own target block in every replicate (51/1071 rows = 4.76% remain associated). This can only strengthen the null, never weaken it.
The audited null design permits fixed points (it is not a derangement); fixed-point counts are recorded per replicate.
B = 100 bounds the resolution of the upper-tail statistic at 1/101; no conclusion is drawn from tail resolution finer than that.
Cross-layout transfer is heterogeneous with per-layout sign reversals; equal-layout macro means conceal that heterogeneity and are never read alone.

The scramble control demonstrates dependence on stable token-slot correspondence. It is NOT attention, saliency, causal localization, or evidence that individual tokens encode absolute position; transformer tokens are contextual.
FULL (688,128 features) shows no material advantage over COARSE (24,576). High-dimensional overfit is neither demonstrated nor eliminated.
Only three trajectories per layout and six layouts; trajectory- and layout-level effects are estimated from few independent units.
No pair holdout, occupancy analysis, U1/U2 objective, condition shift, or new representation was run.
The original MVP status NOT_INTERPRETABLE_POSITIVE_CONTROL_FAILED is historical authority and is unchanged by this work.

components.action: Adopt COARSE_2x6 (24,576 features) or a similarly compact spatially preserving readout as the preferred measurement path; do not return to global mean pooling and do not default to FULL_TOKEN_GRID.
components.basis: COARSE matches FULL within and across layout while using 28x fewer features, and both collapse under sample-specific spatial scramble.

components.action: Design and collect target trajectories whose x_true_blocks profiles vary in direction, timing, speed, starting point and temporal shape enough that a whole-trajectory block permutation destroys target alignment and the audited grouped null collapses toward chance.
components.basis: The audited grouped null reaches a median macro R2 of 0.1323 (COARSE) and 0.2619 (FULL) purely from preserved trajectory-level temporal structure.
components.explicit_anti_pattern: Do NOT collect more trajectories that merely repeat the same stereotyped ramp; additional stereotyped trajectories cannot separate observed performance from this null.

next_project_direction.rationale: The evidence simultaneously supports keeping a compact spatially preserving readout and redesigning the target trajectories, because Control A shows spatial structure carries the measurement gain while Control B shows the current capture design confounds that gain with a stereotyped temporal ramp shared across trajectories.

statements_explicitly_not_made: the visible-position positive control is retrospectively passed
